_doc: Ducking (T4.14, FR-PLAY-011, docs/04 §7 — copy of F-04: Windows communications ducking, Discord attenuation, Android transient focus). Another application counts as sounding when its session peak stays at or above threshold_db for onset_ms; Sirtone comes back hold_ms after it falls quiet. Sensitivity picks the pair. poll_ms — how often the sessions are looked at. builtin_ignore: never counted — tools that capture Sirtone itself (their session carries Sirtone's own sound back).
